preconditions.description: Input integers n and k satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 10^5.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is a positive integer between 1 and n.
The output is a permutation (all integers are distinct).

postconditions.expression: len({abs(int(stdout.split()[i]) - int(stdout.split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)}) == k
postconditions.description: The set of absolute differences between consecutive elements in the permutation has exactly k distinct values.
